stem: Name the city of Russia that is known as 'Venice of North'.

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above / More than one of the above

expl: Saint Petersburg is a city in Russia that is located on the Neva River. St. Petersburg is one of a group of 7 cities often called, "The Venice of the North"; it shares this name with Amsterdam, Bruges, Copenhagen, Hamburg, Manchester and Stockholm.

stem: Which of the following is known as ‘the Continent of Birds’?
expl: 11000 species of birds worldwide and around 3402 bird species found in the South American continent. That is why the South America is often called a (Bird continent).

stem:
Match the following-A. Niagara Falls 1. Pamir
B. The land of thousand lakes 2. Paris
C. Eiffel Tower 3. Finland
D. The Roof of the World 4. New York State
Code : A B C D
expl: Niagara Falls is located in North America on the Niagara River on the border of the United States of America and Canada. Finland is often called the land of a thousand lakes. Eiffel Tower is situated in Paris. Gustave Eiffel, a French civil engineer, is credited with designing the tower that bears his name. The Eiffel Tower is 330 meters tall. Pamir Plateau is also known as the Roof of the World. It is the meeting point of several mountains. The southern border of Central Asia is determined by the Pamir Plateau.

stem: Which of the following city is known by the name of the city of smoke?
expl: The problem of smoking in Chicago was so huge that the government had to bring an ordinance in the year 2005 to ban smoking. Chicago is also known as the ‘city of smoke’.

stem: Which of the following is known as ‘Mistress of Eastern Sea’?
expl: ‘The Mistress of the Eastern Sea’ title is given to Sri Lanka. Sri Lanka is an island situated in the Indian Ocean, at the base of the Indian Sub-Continent, 880 km north of the Equator. It is also known as ‘The Pearl of Indian Ocean’.

stem: Which city of South America is known as ‘The Paris of America’ due to its wide roads?
expl: Buenos Aires is the capital and largest city of Argentina. It is also known as 'the Paris of South America'.

stem: Which state of the U.S.A. is also known as the 'Blue Grass State'?
expl: Kentucky, situated in East South-Central region of the USA is also known as the “Blue Grass State”.

stem: Which city of Turkey is known as the `Gateway to the West' ?
expl: Istanbul is located in the peninsular area of Turkiye whose three sides are surrounded by the Marmara Sea, Bosporus Straits and Golden Horn. It is also known as the Gateway to the West'.

stem: Which country is called “Land of White Elephants”?
expl: Thailand is also known as the 'Land of White Elephants'. The white elephant is considered holy in Thailand.

stem: Which country is famous by the name of the land of the rising sun?
expl: Japanese also call their country Nippon which means the land of the rising sun. Thus, Japan is also known as the land of the rising sun.

stem: Which of the following countries is called ‘Garden of Lakes’?
expl: Finland is also called ‘the Garden of Lakes’or the Land of aThousand Lakes. More than one lakh lakes are found in Finland.

stem: Which of the following cities is known as the 'city of canals'?
expl: Venice is known as the city of canals. It is one of the most beautiful cities in the world. It is also known as the 'Queen of the Adriatic'.

stem: Which one of the following is known as the city of the golden gate ?
expl: Golden Gate Bridge is located in San Francisco city and connects both ends of San Francisco Bay. Therefore, San Francisco is known as the city of the golden gate'.

stem: Which of the following cities is called ‘Manchester of East’?
expl: Osaka (Japan) is called 'Manchester of the East'. Osaka city is located in the Kansai region of Japan. It is the capital city of Osaka province. Historically the trade city Osaka is also famous by the name of ‘Nation's Kitchen’.

stem: Which one of the following is called the 'Pearl of Siberia'?
expl: Lake Baikal is the world's oldest and deepest freshwater lake. Lake Baikal is called "Pearl of Siberia'.

stem: Which one of the following is called the 'Land of Morning calm'?
expl: South Korea is called ' Land of Morning Calm' because of its spellbinding natural beauty, high mountains, clear waters, and its splendid tranquility, particularly in the morning.

stem: Which of the following cities is known as the oil capital of Europe?
expl: Aberdeen is often referred to as the Oil Capital of Europe. The petroleum industry in Aberdeen grew with the discovery of significant oil deposits in the North Sea in the mid-nineteenth century.

stem: Which of the following Island is known as "The Land of Promise"?
expl: Mindanao is known as 'The Land of Promise". Mindanao is an island in the Philippines archipelago.
